Yeah Press / Ansible is not yet compatible with Ubuntu 24.04, you should instantiate with Ubuntu 22.04 your Servers/Database Servers/Proxy Servers. (Press itself is compatible because you most likelly install it manually without Ansible).

Unrelated, but I don’t know where to put this: I also noticed that the “experimental” setting in /etc/docker/daemon.json could cause issues. (systemctl restart docker + systemctl restart docker.socket)
